content.title: Oscars 2026: Full list of nominees and winners
content.text: Hollywood’s biggest night has come and gone. Conan O’Brien returned Sunday to host the star-studded Oscars 2026 ceremony at the Dolby Theater in Los Angeles. Ryan Coogler’s “Sinners,” starring best actor winner Michael B. Jordan, scored a historic 16 Oscar nominations this year, breaking the previous record of 14 held by “All About Eve,” “Titanic” and “La La Land.” Paul Thomas Anderson’s “One Battle After Another” ran close behind “Sinners” with 13 noms, followed by Guillermo del Toro’s “Frankenstein” with nine. Conan O’Brien returned to the Dolby Theater to host the 98th Academy Awards on March 15. ABC Timothée Chalamet, meanwhile, picked up his third acting nod for “Marty Supreme” after 2017’s “Call Me By Your Name” and last year’s “A Complete Unknown,” although the Josh Safdie-directed film failed to bring home any trophies. Other A-listers that duked it out for best actor included Leonardo DiCaprio (“One Battle After Another”), Ethan Hawke (“Blue Moon”) and Wagner Moura (“The Secret Agent”). As for best actress, Jessie Buckley won for “Hamnet,” coming out on top against Rose Byrne (“If I Had Legs I’d Kick You”), Kate Hudson (“Song Sung Blue”), Renate Reinsve (“Sentimental Value”) and Emma Stone (“Bugonia”). Check out the complete list of nominees and winners from the Oscars 2026 below. Ryan Coogler’s “Sinners” achieved a historic 16 Oscar nominations this year.
